name: migrate

test_list.description: An empty database is migrated to SCHEMA_VERSION with the sessions table and the trigram FTS table.
A v0 fixture (generated at test time, with rows) is upgraded in place and every row survives with defaults for the new columns.
Running migrate on an up-to-date database changes nothing and returns the same version.
A database whose user_version is above SCHEMA_VERSION is refused with SchemaTooNew and left untouched.
A v0 fixture that makes a step fail midway leaves user_version and the table layout exactly as before and reports Migration { from, to }.

output_description: The schema version after migration; forward-only; all pending steps and the version bump commit in one transaction.
